title: CLI-first compact bootstrap modal and topology explainer with upgrade state variants
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Goal: Deliver a compact, CLI-first quickstart modal and an accompanying visual topology explainer set plus explicit upgrade-state mockups for the Private/VPC product experience. This ticket covers microcopy, progressive disclosure patterns for non-admin installers, a condensed modal that appears on first sign-in to a private control plane, and a small library of annotated screenshots for docs and release notes. The output must include: 1) a compact bootstrap modal with two variant flows (interactive CLI stride and browser-led guided flow), 2) an explainer topology diagram that highlights required inbound/outbound rules and default port mappings in a single-panel visual for docs, 3) four upgrade modal states (pre-check, in-progress with streaming logs, rollback prompt, success with post-upgrade checklist), 4) a small screenshot pack in two sizes (1024x640 and 1600x900) and matching alt-text/short captions for accessibility and release notes. Constraints: the modal must be readable at small sizes, copy must avoid platform jargon for newcomer-friendly UX, and all visuals must include clear CTA/risk indicators for network and KMS steps. This ticket intentionally focuses on visual language and microcopy so engineering integration (CLI flags and installer exit codes) are tracked in ENG-22933; PM acceptance criteria are in PM-4021. Deliverables are Figma files, export-ready PNGs, example markdown snippets for the docs site, and a short companion microcopy doc for translations.
acceptance_criteria: Compact bootstrap modal has two validated variants (CLI-first and browser-guided) with finalized microcopy and annotated states
Topology explainer single-panel clearly maps network flow arrows, required ports, and suggested NAT/egress rules; passes technical review by ENG-22933
Upgrade modal shows four discrete states with handoff copy and fallback links; visuals include log streaming mock and rollback confirmation
Screenshot pack includes 6 images (2 modal sizes x 3 states) exported at 1024x640 and 1600x900 with alt-text and captions
Designs landed in Figma and PR created with exported assets and markdown snippets for docs; review comments resolved
Security team sign-off obtained for KMS/HSM language and no secrets are embedded in screenshots
